info.title: Hubble ERC-8004 Market Server
info.description: Backend API for ERC-8004 Agent Marketplace

post.description:
Get authentication challenge.

Client provides wallet address and chain ID, server returns nonce and message to sign.

Args:
    request: Authentication challenge request

Returns:
    Authentication challenge response with nonce and message to sign

Raises:
    HTTPException: If cache is full, returns 429 Too Many Requests

User login.

Client signs the challenge message with wallet private key and submits the signature for verification.
Returns JWT access token upon successful verification.

Args:
    request: Login request

Returns:
    Login response with JWT access token and user information

Raises:
    HTTPException: If signature verification fails

get.description:
Get current logged-in user profile.

Requires valid JWT token in request header.

Args:
    current_user: Current user (injected via dependency)

Returns:
    User profile response

post.description:
Create a new Agent.

Requires authentication. Only draft status Agents can be created, which can be published to chain later via the publish endpoint.

Args:
    request: Agent creation request
    current_user: Current user (via dependency injection)

Returns:
    Created Agent ID

Raises:
    HTTPException: If LLM Provider or DataSource does not exist

get.description:
Query Agent list (supports pagination and filtering).

No authentication required, but unauthenticated users can only see published Agents.
Authenticated users can see all their own Agents and published Agents from others.

Args:
    pagination: Pagination parameters
    is_published: Whether published (optional)
    owner_id: Owner ID (optional)
    llm_provider_id: LLM Provider ID (optional)
    search: Search keyword (optional)
    current_user: Current user (optional, via dependency injection)

Returns:
    Agent list response

Raises:
    HTTPException: If unauthenticated user tries to query Agents of a specific owner

Get Agent details.

No authentication required, but only the owner can view unpublished Agents.

Args:
    agent_id: Agent ID
    current_user: Current user (optional, via dependency injection)

Returns:
    Agent detail response

Raises:
    HTTPException: If Agent does not exist or no permission to access

put.description:
Update Agent.

Requires authentication, only the owner can update. Only updates the provided fields.

Args:
    agent_id: Agent ID
    request: Agent update request
    current_user: Current user (via dependency injection)

Returns:
    Updated Agent details

Raises:
    HTTPException: If Agent does not exist, no permission, or update failed

delete.description:
Delete Agent.

Requires authentication, only the owner can delete.

Args:
    agent_id: Agent ID
    current_user: Current user (via dependency injection)

Raises:
    HTTPException: If Agent does not exist or no permission

post.description:
Publish Agent to chain.

Requires authentication, only the owner can publish. Creates an async publish task and returns task ID.

Args:
    agent_id: Agent ID
    request: Publish request (includes force parameter)
    current_user: Current user (via dependency injection)

Returns:
    Publish task details

Raises:
    HTTPException: If Agent does not exist, no permission, or task creation failed

get.description:
Query Agent publish task status.

Used to poll publish progress.

Args:
    agent_id: Agent ID
    job_id: Task ID
    current_user: Current user (optional, via dependency injection)

Returns:
    Publish task details

Raises:
    HTTPException: If task does not exist or Agent ID does not match

post.description:
Initiate Agent run.

Requires authentication. Creates run instance and triggers async task.

**Payment Flow**:
1. First call: If Agent requires payment, creates run record and returns 402 status with payment requirements
2. Second call: With X-PAYMENT header, verifies payment then triggers run task

Args:
    agent_id: Agent ID
    request_body: run request (contains input data)
    fastapi_request: FastAPI Request object
    current_user: current user (via dependency injection)
    x_payment: X-PAYMENT header (optional, provided on second request)

Returns:
    - 202: AgentRunResponse - run created
    - 402: PaymentRequiredResponse - payment required

Raises:
    HTTPException: if Agent doesn't exist or operation fails

schema.title: Response Create Agent Run Api V1 Agents  Agent Id  Runs Post

get.description:
Query Agent run status.

Used for polling run progress. Requires authentication, can only query own runs.

Args:
    agent_id: Agent ID
    run_id: run ID
    current_user: current user (via dependency injection)

Returns:
    run details (including event list)

Raises:
    HTTPException: if run doesn't exist or no permission

post.description:
Submit, revoke, or append response to feedback.

Currently only supports the respond operation; for submit/revoke use the auth + receipts flow.

Authentication required. Only published Agents can accept feedback.

Args:
    agent_id: Agent ID
    request: Feedback request
    current_user: Current user (via dependency injection)

Returns:
    Feedback job response (task will be processed asynchronously)

Raises:
    HTTPException: If Agent does not exist, is not published, or user lacks permission

get.description:
Query feedback list for Agent.

Supports pagination and operation type filtering. No authentication required, everyone can view feedback.

Args:
    agent_id: Agent ID
    pagination: Pagination parameters
    operation: Operation type filter (optional)

Returns:
    Feedback list response

post.description: Submit feedback receipt signed by client.

get.description:
Query feedback job status.

Used by frontend to poll task progress. Authentication required, can only query own tasks or completed tasks.

Args:
    agent_id: Agent ID (for path completeness, not actually used)
    job_id: Task ID
    current_user: Current user (via dependency injection)

Returns:
    Feedback job response

Raises:
    HTTPException: If task does not exist or no permission

List all Agents created by the current user.

Includes both published and unpublished Agents.
Requires authentication.

Args:
    current_user: Current user (via dependency injection)
    pagination: Pagination parameters

Returns:
    Paginated list of Agents

View all Agent execution history initiated by the current user.

Returns in descending order by creation time.
Requires authentication.

Args:
    current_user: Current user (via dependency injection)
    pagination: Pagination parameters

Returns:
    Paginated list of execution history

Query available LLM Provider list.

No authentication required, returns all configured LLM Providers.

Returns:
    List of LLM Providers

schema.title: Response List Llm Providers Api V1 Config Llm Providers Get

get.description:
Query available DataSource list.

No authentication required, returns all configured DataSources.

Returns:
    List of DataSources

AgentCreateRequest.title: AgentCreateRequest
AgentCreateRequest.description:
Create Agent request.

Attributes:

    description: Agent description (optional)
    llm_provider_id: LLM Provider ID
    data_source_id: Data source ID
    system_prompt: System Prompt
    user_prompt_template: User input template (optional)

    pricing_model: Pricing model (free/fixed/usage)
    price_amount: Price amount (required when pricing_model is not free)
    currency: Currency (required when pricing_model is not free)
    requires_user_input: Whether user input is required

PaymentRequiredResponse.title: PaymentRequiredResponse
PaymentRequiredResponse.description:
402 response returned when first call requires payment.

This response tells the client that payment is required to continue.

PaymentStatus.title: PaymentStatus
PaymentStatus.description:
x402 payment state machine.

State transition description:
- NONE: No payment required
- REQUIRED: API returns 402, waiting for frontend to initiate signature
- PENDING_SIGNATURE: User clicked payment but signature not completed
- PENDING: Signature submitted, facilitator processing
- CONFIRMED: Payment completed, can proceed to execution
- FAILED: Payment failed or timed out
